AGB SDK multi-play SIO sample MultiSioMain: master/slave decision, waits 8 frames, MultiSio_CheckRecvData; returns the status word (receive bits, connected bits << 8, 0x80 master, 0x1000 error, 0x2000 id >= 2, 0x8000 synced)
MultiSioSendDataSet: builds the next 0x18-byte packet (frame counter, error flags, 16 data bytes, checksum ~sum-12)
MultiSioRecvDataCheck: runs the IWRAM copy of arm_08032B7C, copies packets with a valid checksum (sum == -13) to recvp + 16*player
master: once started, swaps buffers and starts the transfer (SIOMLT_SEND 0xFEFE, SIOCNT start, TM3CNT_H 0xC0); slave: re-arms the serial interrupt check
ARM, copied to 0x030062B0 by Link_InitSerial: with IME off swaps the current/last receive buffer pointers (0x030061C0+0x24/+0x28) and returns and clears the receive-done flag (+5)
sends packet 0xC100 with an 8-byte id once SIO status bit 8 is set, then compares both players' ids (sub_080DF6FC(0xC100)); returns 1 when equal
sends 0xF100, 0xF200, 0xF300 in turn until both players echo each (state 0x030062F4 1-5), restarts after 60 frames (max 20) and fails after 600 error frames (0xFF); returns 1 when done
